plain: Harming a person's good name with false statements.

webster.text: Calumnious; slanderous; containing defamation; false and injurious to reputation; as defamatory words; defamatory reports or writings.

example.quote: No inference is here intended, that the laws, provided by the State against false and defamatory publications, should not be enforced;
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Second Inaugural Address, Mar. 4, 1805
